newsitem.title: SPAIN: Baron de Ley IPO so far 15 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Baron de Ley IPO so far 15 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Demand for the initial public offering of Spanish wine producer Baron de Ley was 15 times the original offer by Wednesday, Baron de Ley said in a statement.
In the first five days of the offer, demand had reached 150 billion pesetas from domestic and international institutional investors, it said.
Requests for shares must be made by July 11 and the final price of the share will be made known on July 14, in a range between 1,950 and 2,250 pesetas per share.
The group is selling up to 74.6 percent of its capital or 5,407,860 shares.
